verdict.rationale: Lithic's ASA docs mention that authorization requests include 'transaction metadata' delivered via HTTP during the auth stream, implying some contextual data is passed, but the evidence never specifies merchant name/MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet/entry-mode details, or partial-approval/incremental-auth signals. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC/merchant name fields, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signal support.
